text: CONTRADICTING: Astrocytes treated with ApoE4 particles had lower cathepsin D activity than ApoE3- or ApoE2-treated astrocytes. This is consistent with impaired, less acidic endolysosomes rather than increased acidification.
description: Primary hippocampal astrocytes from P0-P1 wild-type Sprague-Dawley rats, grown in 6-well dishes. Incubated in HBSS ± 50 µg/ml ApoE2, ApoE3 or ApoE4/POPC particles for 4 h; lysates assayed with an Abcam cathepsin D activity kit and normalized to untreated control. n = 6 independent experiments. Caveat: rat, exogenous particles; cathepsin D activity depends on lysosomal pH but also on enzyme maturation and delivery, so it is a weak pH surrogate.

provenance.excerpt: Indeed, astrocytes treated with ApoE4 particles had decreased activity of the endolysosomal protease cathepsin D (Figure 3C).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4 particles) -> (decreased endolysosomal cathepsin D activity in astrocytes) [CONTRADICTS]
